psychological_meaning: Pine Tree green evokes feelings of nature, growth, and tranquility. It represents stability, endurance, and a connection to the earth. It is often associated with harmony, peace, and a sense of groundedness. This color can also suggest wealth, prosperity, and environmental awareness.
